items.action: Build after upgrading, and rename a member of yours the compiler reports as colliding.
items.appliesWhen: Only a class of yours that extends TooltipDirective or TooltipPanelComponent. Template users of dsTooltip need nothing; subclassing a DS component is unsupported.
items.pitfall: A redeclared private member collides as a public one does, and override cannot resolve it (TS2415); only a rename does.
items.verify: The app builds with no TS2415 or TS4114 against TooltipDirective or TooltipPanelComponent.
items.note: TooltipDirective gained the public dsTooltipPinOnClick, the protected onClick and onPointerLeave, and the private document, hostPinOnClick, pinsOnClick, clippedLead, pin, unpin and pointArrowAtHost. TooltipPanelComponent gained the public lead.

items.action: None, unless a tooltip of yours relies on a line break in its text: give it one line, or move the first line into dsTooltipClippedLead where it is the host's own clipped label.
items.appliesWhen: A dsTooltip string, or the text a dsTooltipWhenClipped host discloses, that contains a newline. A text on one line is unchanged.
items.pitfall: A list joined with newlines reads as one run-on line; the build and a unit test both pass over it.
items.verify: Hover each tooltip whose text comes from data joined with newlines and confirm it reads as one line.

informational: dsTooltipPinOnClick opens a tooltip on hover and focus with no delay and keeps it open after a click until a click outside, Escape or blur; a second click closes it. Without it a click closes the tooltip as before.
ds-info-hint (InfoHintComponent) is an info icon button: ariaLabel names it, text shows on hover and focus and stays open after a click.

button[dsDefinitionTerm] (DefinitionTermComponent) styles a button as a term with a dotted underline in --text-tertiary and shows its definition on hover and focus, pinned on click; [pinOnClick]="false" turns the pin off.

informational.text: dsTooltipClippedLead renders as a bold line above the tooltip text. A ds-table header label with a hint is a button[dsDefinitionTerm]: a plain label pins its hint on click, a sortable one sorts on click and pins nothing.
informational.verify: narrow a hinted ds-table column until its label clips, hover it and confirm the label is bold on the first line with the hint under it; click a plain hinted label, move the pointer away and confirm the hint stays until a click outside.

informational.text: A tooltip's arrow points at the centre of its trigger when the panel is pushed off a viewport edge; a panel centred on its trigger looks the same.
informational.verify: open a tooltip on a trigger near the left and the right viewport edge and confirm the arrow sits under the trigger's centre.

deleteList.why: A tooltip reads a line break as a space.
ds-info-hint renders the icon button, its accessible name and the pinned tooltip.
deleteList.replaceWith: <ds-info-hint ariaLabel="..." text="..." />; keep a hand-built button whose click does something besides showing the text

deleteList.why: button[dsDefinitionTerm] carries the button reset, the dotted underline, the focus ring and the pinned tooltip.
deleteList.replaceWith: <button type="button" dsDefinitionTerm="...">; keep a dotted underline that marks something other than a term with a definition
